caption: The video showcases a top-down close view of hazelnuts scattered on a dark matte surface, lit from one side so each nut casts a soft shadow. A loose, dense cluster occupies the center and right of the frame, while a few isolated nuts lie near the upper-left edge. The center and right cluster stays fixed, with positions, orientations, and pale scarred bases unchanged. Near the upper-left edge, a small group of hazelnuts rolls slowly, their light circular bases becoming more visible. As they roll, their positions shift slightly, and one nut drifts toward the top border but remains visible. The background texture and shadows of the stationary nuts stay aligned with the surface, so the visible changes are object motion rather than camera movement.
